scope: Unmodified installed app copy; pinned repository Electron; native main/utility workers/preload/sandbox/IPC/resource routes/renderer. Native dialogs stubbed to isolated library, window show:false. DOM waits plus two animation frames, explicit image.decode includes protocol reads and raster decode. No recompilation.
limitations: Synthetic text and shared original source images; no provider/host launch/native Finder dialog or manual visual acceptance.
One Mac, one fresh fixture, one process; OS page cache is warm after snapshot/seeding. No latency SLA or capacity guarantee.
Timings are sequential wall-clock observations; image decode tests eagerly load selected page images, and do not measure a human scrolling gesture.
Memory units: process.memoryUsage bytes; renderer/process metrics report KiB as provided by Electron.
